Newsletter June 2024

Dear members,

Module 4 is well underway and the summer break is already coming close. We still have some great events coming up! Be sure to come by.
 

Kind regards, 
Max Jansdam

Secretary of Blueshell

 

TABLE OF CONTENTS

  • Active Members Activity
  • This was May
  • What is coming up in June
  • Esports Update
­

AMA

Dear active members of Blueshell.
As announced last month we have our AMA barbecue on the 21st of June. Be sure to sign up if you have not done so already!

Everyone who has taken part in a committee or played in a team for Blueshell can come! 

 

Hope to see you all there

Max Jansdam

Secretary of Blueshell

 
­

How was the last month

May

Last month we had a few great events. We also had a couple of collaboration events last month

DisCo Rythem and Dance Dance Revolution night with Bellettrie

Batavieren with Dorans

­

Upcoming in June 

The Weekly gamenights organised by the board continue! Be sure to come by the lounge and have a drink (They might not all be listed below, but are every monday). 

Committee events are happening. Be sure to check them out!

 
­

Esports

Some playoffs are still happening, while other teams are going into the second stage of the Blueshell Circuit Showdown

 

Rocket League

Blueshell Turtles 

The Turtles has been losing in the BSCS so far (Because everyone banned Rocket league against them), but they have the chance to turn it around in the next few games!

BS Oogway

Oogway did not play this month.

BS Squirtles

Squirtles is the only Blueshell team that is still playing in DLRLS and is now going to battle for third place of division 1. Lets cheer them on

 

League of Legends 

BS Scaling

Scaling decided to take NyperS on in their home turf and lost 0-2 because of it. After that they managed to beat turtles 2-0, giving them a solid standing for the second part of the BSCS

BS Happy Hour

Happy Hour has been fighting in through the BSCS. They managed to win their LoL against the fanclub but sadly lost the rest. 

 

Valorant

Bs Tempra

Did not play

IcySpicy

Did not play

WaterBoarders

Waterboarders got a 1-1 against the fanclub and 2-0 against Happy Hour. Dominating the stage in the shooters. Lets hope they can keep it up

 

CS2

HyperS

HyperS won in division and is now playing as NyperS in the BSCS. Here they got Joran to play League of Legends. I thought it would never happen... Oh and they won everything so far, making them the top team in our showdown for now.
